events.title: John Aldridge agrees to leave 리버풀 after nearly three years to join 레알 소시에다드 of Spain for £750,000.
England draw 0–0 against Sweden in their fifth World Cup qualifier at Wembley.

밀월 beat 코번트리 시티 4–1 at The Den to go top of the First Division in only their second season in the top flight. 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose for third successive game, going down 3–2 to 에버턴 at Goodison Park . An eight-goal thriller at Carrow Road sees 노리치 시티 and 사우샘프턴 draw 4–4. In the Second Division, there are nine goals at Bramall Lane as 셰필드 유나이티드 beat Brighton 5–4 to go top of the table.
리버풀 defeat 크리스털 팰리스 9–0 , with eight different players scoring, including John Aldridge in his last appearance for the club.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign midfielder 폴 인스 from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £1 million.
퀸스 파크 레인저스 pay £175,000 for 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 defender David Bardsley , with striker Mark Stein moving to the Manor Ground in exchange.

Ten 스완지 시티 fans receive 16–month prison sentences in Athens after being convicted of fighting with 파나시나이코스 fans after a European Cup Winners' Cup tie. 마크 휴스 scores the season's first hat-trick in the First Division as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 밀월 5–1 at Old Trafford . 에버턴 go top of the First Division with a 1–0 win over Charlton at Selhurst Park .
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign winger Danny Wallace from 사우샘프턴 for £1.2 million.

맨체스터 시티 thrash neighbours United 5–1 in the first Manchester derby since the 1986–87 season . 리버풀 win 3–1 at Goodison Park in the Merseyside derby , with 이언 러시 scoring twice. 셰필드 유나이티드 are top of the Second Division, with 블랙번 로버스 second, level on points with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 선덜랜드 , 리즈 유나이티드 and Brighton & Hove Albion complete the top six. 레스터 시티 , often among the pre–season promotion favourites for the last three seasons, prop up the table and are in danger of relegation to the Third Division for the first time in their history.
리버풀 and 첼시 are level on points at the top of the First Division at the end of the month. 셰필드 웬즈데이, 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 languish in the relegation zone.
